rules.name: reading-ink-pink
rules.summary: Deployed reading ink is pink #ff6bbc (body/heads/footer/forms) with neon-green links #6bff2c on a dotted blue underline; per-page black-body flips (project pages, .publication) and per-page h1 hues are sanctioned parts of the system. Contrast below AA is measured and recorded (prohibition/unreadable-accent-ink).
rules.why: Pass 2 extracted what the site IS: the pink/neon ink layer is the deployment's signature, not an accident. Recorded contrast: pink-on-white 2.6:1, green-on-white 1.32:1.
rules.fix: Follow the deployed ink map; where a consumer needs AA compliance, use the sanctioned black-body override (already in the system) and file the divergence as a gap.

rules.name: radius-map
rules.summary: Radius map as deployed: 0px on checkbox marks (checkbox only), boxes, .image spans, icon chips (style2) and tiles; 100% on radios and logo/icon discs; 4px kept on buttons, inline code, nav plates and tile captions.
rules.why: Half the template's 4px family was intentionally flattened; the remainder holds. Both values are canonical in their mapped places.
rules.fix: Apply the map above by component; do not blanket-flatten or blanket-restore.

rules.name: tracked-caps-display
rules.summary: Caps voice (uppercase 900, +0.35em) runs h2–h4, wordmark, nav and buttons; h1 stays sentence-case 700 with −0.035em; table heads are 900 mixed case; labels and menu links stay 300.
rules.why: Measured across type, buttons, menu and tables; the mixed-case exceptions are as deliberate as the caps.
rules.fix: Apply the caps voice to the list above; never caps-track running text; keep table heads mixed case.

rules.name: flat-inset-rings
rules.summary: Depth is drawn with inset rings (inset 0 0 0 Npx), hairlines and rules — no blurred/elevation shadows exist anywhere in the system.
rules.why: Shadow census on the deployed render finds inset rings only; the flat surface is the system's honesty.
rules.fix: Replace drop shadows with inset rings or 1px rules.

rules.name: underline-fields
rules.summary: Fields are underline-only on white: no box, radius 0, 1px #c9c9c9 bottom line; focus = 2px pink #f2849e underline (border + inset). Select and textarea follow.
rules.why: Measured on every input; the box-less language keeps the page rhythm.
rules.fix: Strip field boxes; keep the bottom line and the pink focus underline.

rules.name: link-trio
rules.summary: A content link carries three colours at once: text #6bff2c, dotted 1px #20a3f5 underline, #f2849e hover (underline goes transparent). The underline is the link's findability anchor under failing contrast; the hover pink is the template accent.
rules.why: Measured as one wrapped rule on all 9 pages; removing any leg changes the system.
rules.fix: Keep the trio intact; do not 'fix' the link colour without re-opening the ink decision.

rules.name: per-page-override-pattern
rules.summary: Global pink ink is overridden per page: light/tame/fafa/Unlogical inject one identical style block (body #fbfbfb + black text) and recolour only their h1 via inline style; publication adds a .publication class painting its main text black while header/footer stay pink.
rules.why: This override mechanism is the system's actual extension model for 'quieter' pages; new pages should follow it rather than introduce new mechanisms.
rules.fix: To quiet a page, reuse the shared style block + one h1 accent; do not fork the global stylesheet.

rules.name: state-colour-pink
rules.summary: One interaction-state colour: #f2849e. It is the hover label+ring on buttons, field/select focus underline, icon-chip hover glyph+border, :active ground at 10% alpha, and link hover. Measured on every interactive control.
rules.why: Single accent keeps the state language coherent (2.45:1 on white — state emphasis only, never reading ink).
rules.fix: Use #f2849e for state emphasis; do not add a second state colour.
